Why this site exists

Severe obesity (generally a BMI of 40 or more, or 35 or more with related health conditions) is complex. It is influenced by genetics, hormones, sleep, stress, environment and medical conditions, not just willpower. People do better with accurate information, medical support and a community that does not judge.
